title: The Nine's message: surveillance of Earth, wars and nuclear weapons

plain: Between 1952 and 1979, a council of beings called the Nine is said to have spoken through sessions held at the Round Table Foundation, a private research group in Maine, warning that they had been watching Earth and seeing its wars and nuclear weapons. The researcher Greg Malatzi summarises this on the show from the transcripts of those sessions, which involve a man called Dr. Vinod, saying the beings had been 'monitoring Earth' and 'seeing the negative things happening'. If true, it would mean outside intelligences were tracking humanity's turn toward nuclear danger.
